review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The mutation replaces a conditional integrity check (`if reconstructed_digest != manifest.snapshot_digest:`) with `if False:`, which permanently disables the branch that would execute when the reconstructed digest does not match the manifest snapshot digest. In the original code, a mismatch between digests triggers whatever logic follows (e.g., raising an error, returning a failure response, logging a security violation). With `if False:`, that branch is never entered regardless of digest values, meaning digest mismatches are silently ignored. This produces an observable behavioral difference: inputs that previously caused the mismatch-handling code to execute will now proceed as if the digests matched, changing the output or side effects of the governed system.
